name: ProjectSight MCP Server
description: Provides access to the ProjectSight API for managing construction portfolios, projects, and records like ActionItems, RFIs, and Submittals. It features a modular architecture supporting CRUD operations, workflow state management, and OAuth2 authentication.

rawRecord.description: Provides access to the ProjectSight API for managing construction portfolios, projects, and records like ActionItems, RFIs, and Submittals. It features a modular architecture supporting CRUD operations, workflow state management, and OAuth2 authentication.

MCP_HOST.description: The host to bind to when running in HTTP mode.

MCP_PORT.description: The port to bind to when running in HTTP mode.

CLIENT_ID.description: Your Consumer Key (CLIENT_ID) from Trimble API Cloud.

PORTFOLIO_ID.description: Either an integer AccountID (e.g., 1, 2, 3) or a Portfolio GUID in UUID format.

CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your Consumer Secret (CLIENT_SECRET) from Trimble API Cloud.

APPLICATION_NAME.description: Your Application Name from Trimble API Cloud.

PROJECTSIGHT_SCOPE.description: The API subscription region scope (e.g., ProjectSight_-_US1, ProjectSight_-_EU1, or ProjectSight_-_US2).

PROJECTSIGHT_API_URL.description: The base URL for the ProjectSight API.
